items.title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
items.summary: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.
